description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map3_s06.tell_me_everything_you_know:
{wait1 3.0}Tell me everything you know.
What's going on?
strings.map3_s06.the_town_is_being_devoured:
{wait1 3.9}The town is being devoured
by darkness.
strings.map3_s06.strength_must_overcome_petty:
{wait1 5.8}Strength must overcome
petty desire.
Childish sleep talk.
strings.map3_s06.what_are_you_talking_about:
{wait1 4.0}What are you talking about?
I don't understand a word of this.{end}
strings.map3_s06.the_other_church_in_this:
{wait 5.3}The other church in this town.
That is your destination.
strings.map3_s06.this_is_beyond_my_abilities:
{wait 6.5}This is beyond my abilities.
Only you can stop it now.{end}
strings.map3_s06.have_you_not_seen_the:
{wait 5.0}Have you not seen
the crest marked
on the ground all over town?
strings.map3_s06.so_thats_what_i_saw:
{wait 3.2}So that's what I saw
in the schoolyard.
strings.map3_s06.the_elevator_doesnt_appear_to:
The elevator doesn't
appear to be working.{end}
strings.map3_s06.there_is_an_antique_shop:
There is an {color 2}Antique shop key{/color}.
Take it?{choice 4}
strings.map3_s06.these_are_phones_and:
These are phones and phonebooks.
No need to examine this.{end}
strings.map3_s06.ill_copy_the_location_of:
I'll copy the location of
the antique shop to the map.{end}
strings.map3_s06.theres_a_vending_machine_it:
There's a vending machine.
It doesn't work.{end}
strings.map3_s06.theres_a_white_board_nothing:
There's a white board.
Nothing special written here.{end}
strings.map3_s06.the_phones_out_cant_get:
The phone's out.
Can't get a dial tone.{end}
